# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal or plant for use
with spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many forms studied
as he has levels.
@@ 2
Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170ºF and natural cold down to
20ºF (treat as if target were in 70ºF temperature). For temperatures above
170ºF, subtract 100ºF to determine the effective temperature for the caster.
For temperatures below 20ºF, add 50ºF to determine the effect temperature for
the caster. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat
attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks); as well as +20 to all
RRs versus cold spells and ice attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and ice
attacks). The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if the caster
does not move. If the caster moves, the spell will last as long as the caster
concentrates.
@@ 3
Allows caster to take on the physical coloration of any 1 organic object. The
caster must be in contact with object when the spell is cast. In many
situations this will give a special bonus of +10 to +50 (GM’s discretion) to
Hiding maneuvers (and perhaps to some Stalking maneuvers).
@@ 4
Allows caster to appear as any one type of plant that he has studied. Caster
retains his size and will not smell or feel like the plant (i.e., it is purely
a visual illusion and is subject to illusion rules-see Section 15.14, p. 98,
for more on illusions).
@@ 5
Caster can move silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating
more than 1' from his body.
@@ 6
Caster can breathe normally under water. This spell will not function with any
liquid but water.
@@ 7
Allows caster to appear as any one type of animal that he has studied. Caster
retains his size and will not smell or feel like the animal (i.e., it is
purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules-see Section
15.14, p. 98, for more on illusions).
@@ 8
Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost
invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a
special bonus to Stalking/ Hiding of between +25 and +75).
@@ 9
Any single attack made against the caster this round suffers a -50 modifier.
The weapon or object striking the caster must be from an organic source (i.e.,
an animal) or at least a partially organic weapon (i.e., an arrow).
@@ 10
Allows caster to take the form of any one plant he has studied. The caster
will look and feel like the plant. He can vary his size from 75% of normal to
200% of normal. The caster does not gain the physical abilities of the plant.
See Section 15.20 (p. 100) for more on changing forms.
@@ 11
Caster is protected from any natural heat and natural cold (treat as if target
were in 70ºF temperature). Caster also receives +40 to all RRs versus fire/ice
spells, heat/cold attacks (+40 DB versus elemental attacks). The duration of
this spell is 10 minutes per level if the caster does not move. If the caster
moves, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates.
@@ 12
For the duration of this spell, the caster’s mental patterns will appear to be
those of any animal he has studied. The caster cannot move while this spell is
active.
@@ 13
As Shielding Organic I, except the penalty is -100.
@@ 14
Allows caster to take the form of any one animal he has studied. The caster
will look and feel like the animal. He can vary his size from 75% of normal to
200% of normal. The caster does not gain the physical abilities of the animal.
See Section 15.20 (p. 100) for more on changing forms.
@@ 15
As Animal Thoughts, except caster can move (though he must maintain
concentration).
@@ 16
As Plant Form I, except caster may also assume the scent and physical
abilities of the plant. Caster can vary his size from 50% of normal to 400% of
normal.
@@ 17
As Animal Form I, except caster gains the movement abilities of the chosen
animal. Caster can vary his size from 50% of normal to 400% of normal.
@@ 18
As Shielding Organic I, except attack automatically misses.
@@ 19
As Animal Form II, except caster gains the phsyical attacks of the animal.
Caster can vary his size from 5% of normal to 4000% normal.
@@ 20
As Plant Form II, except the caster can change his form to any other plant he
has studied at any time during the duration of the spell.
@@ 25
As Animal Form III, except the caster can change his form to any other animal
he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell.
@@ 30
As Plant Form II and Animal Form III in operation at the same time.
@@ 50
Each round during the duration of the spell, the caster can negate (i.e.,
cause to miss) one attack directed at him. The attacking weapon must be at
least part organic and he must be able to see the attack.
